name: health-export-mcp
description: Query 190 Apple Health/HealthKit metrics from any MCP AI agent — zero-dependency, local-first, read-only. The open-source server for the Health Export AI app.
longDescription: An open-source, zero-dependency MCP server that turns your Apple Health export into 14 query tools any AI agent can call in natural language. Tracks HRV, sleep, resting heart rate, steps, workouts, VO₂ max, and 180+ more metrics — all local-first with no developer server in the path.
installCommand: git clone https://github.com/PhilipAD/health-export-mcp.git && cd health-export-mcp && node apply-mcp-config.mjs
